defects_found_and_fixed.fix: PrimitiveType.SCANCODE emits wVk=0 + KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE with the extended-key flag, backed by a set-1 scancode table distinct from the virtual-key table

root_cause.why_it_fired: ActionExecutor._release_held() runs on every batch exit and the controller's execute() calls release_all() after each dispatched primitive, so the first action disarmed the manager

symptoms: roughly half the primitives silently dropped
root_cause.why_tests_missed_it: every mock input port accepts primitives regardless of its armed state, so no test could observe the disarm

1_release_all_disarmed.mechanism: release_all() ended with self.enabled = False; executor releases every batch exit and the controller releases after every dispatch
1_release_all_disarmed.evidence: input_audit event 8: unicode count=0 detail='input disarmed'
1_release_all_disarmed.fix: a release sweep reconciles held state, it does not revoke press authority; disarm stays explicit
1_release_all_disarmed.also: blocked_presses counter added and surfaced in the audit
1_release_all_disarmed.why_tests_missed: FakeInput.send consulted only its own _enabled, never safety.enabled, so the fake was more permissive than the real adapter

2_unicode_single_primitive.fix: one primitive per character so interval_ms is honoured; default 12 -> 35 ms

3_unicode_no_keyup.mechanism: _unicode_char sent KEYEVENTF_UNICODE down only, never the paired key-up
3_unicode_no_keyup.evidence: 12 chars delivered to correct focused Notepad, 0 violations, document unchanged
3_unicode_no_keyup.fix: down/up pair submitted in one atomic SendInput via _submit_many(array, count) with an explicit POINTER(_INPUT) cast

4_aborted_run_reported_pass.mechanism: overall_from only sees executed steps, so a run that died mid-scenario reported PASS
4_aborted_run_reported_pass.fix: a green verdict now requires run state to be completed
